step1.hintRole: Tell us a bit about what you do.

step2.introSub: Let's build the frame your clients will sit in. All of it can change later.

modeHelp.solo: Each client sits directly in the project, with their own sessions and payments.
modeHelp.groups: A group is a cohort with a start and an end. Clients join it, and the price and sessions come from it.
modeHelp.both: Some clients in a group, some one to one — all under the same project.

step2.nameHint: We filled it in from what you do — change it if you'd rather.
step2.firstGroupMeta: Price, package and a weekly slot — you can add those later
step2.clientsTeaser: Next step we'll add your first client.
step2.existingBanner: You already have {{count}} projects. Adding here just creates one more.

step3.introSub: A name and a phone number is plenty. Everything else — status, package, price — waits on their own card.

step4.introSub: One goal to start with, monthly. You can change it or add more any time from the goals screen.
step4.personalHint: Learning, making, running — whatever you measure
step4.targetHelp: The number we'll aim for this month.

step5.title: You're all set! Everything's ready
step5.savedNote: It's all saved already — {{verb}} add, edit, or remove anything anytime from the home screen.
step5.emptyNote: You can add clients, goals, tasks, and everything else — easily from the home screen, {{verb}}.
step5.about1: This system is being built for you — to make running your business as easy and as nourishing as possible.
step5.about2: {{verb}} send us feedback, requests, and refinements from the home screen and the menu, so the system can shape itself even more around you.
step5.about3: We care about you — so {{allow}} yourself to act {{like}} and ask for anything you {{wish}}.
step5.about4: We more than hope Simplicity becomes a warm home for your business — and we wish you full, fulfilling success.
